root.label: Ukrainian strikes on Russian defense plants September 25-26

events.label: Ukrainian strikes on Russian defense plants September 25-26

slots.name: buildings struck
slots.sentence: The next day, Ukraine hit the foundry and five buildings of the Azov Optical-Mechanical Plant, which makes optics for artillery, missile and antitank weapons.

slots.name: strike date
slots.sentence: On September 25, it struck the NPP Zavod Iskra factory, which makes electronic components for the Kh-59 cruise missiles Russia flies into Ukraine, and the Pantsir-S air defence system.
